mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/mo.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST exceeding 10% YoY signals a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of months with HOUST YoY growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% and CPIAUCSL growth slows below 2% YoY, a monetary policy tightening cycle signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained RSAFS growth rate above 5% YoY indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with RSAFS YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth slows below 100k/month and UNRATE rises above 6%, a weakening labor market signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with PAYEMS growth < 100k/mo and UNRATE > 6%.
